title: Transfiguration Cathedral

terrainReference.basis: Standard DEM datum54.645605m; estimated model basement base0.5m above it. The retained3m eastern podium/column plane is the raised entry datum, sitting at modelY3.5m above perimeter terrain -1.62..3.28m. Western/side podiums and entry stairs approximate that transition. Foundations follow the terrain; some basement/plinth faces are naturally below the coarse hill. Exact street/door joins, absolute altitude, cut/fill and certified walking unverified; no terrain flattening or bespoke survey.
